jobs.occupation: Startup and Ecosystem Manager – EU Chips Design Platform
jobs.description:
Help Europe’s most ambitious semiconductor startups move from breakthrough ideas to market-ready chips.
Apply About the role 
 

Europe is investing heavily in semiconductor innovation, and the EU Chips Design Platform is at the center of that transformation.

As a Startup and Ecosystem Manager, you'll become a trusted partner for startups, SMEs, research organizations and fabless innovators across Europe. You'll guide them through the platform, connect them with the right expertise and resources, and help accelerate their path from concept to silicon.
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you'll combine ecosystem building, stakeholder management and startup support.

You will:
 
 

• Guide and onboard users of the EU Chips Design Platform throughout their innovation journey. 

• Act as the primary contact for startups, SMEs and research teams using the platform. 

• Manage imec's contribution to the Venture Development Program, including mentoring, incubation and acceleration activities. 

• Support participants in applying for Financial Support to Third Parties (FSTP) funding opportunities. 

• Promote the platform across the European semiconductor ecosystem. 

• Build strong relationships with startups, investors, competence centers and industry stakeholders throughout Europe. 

• Identify opportunities to improve the user experience and continuously strengthen the platform's services. 

• Help shape a thriving European chip design community.

   

Why this role is unique
 

This is more than an account management role. You'll help build the ecosystem that enables the next generation of European chip companies to succeed. It offers the unique combination of: 
 
 

• Direct impact on Europe's semiconductor future. 

• Daily interaction with ambitious deep-tech startups. 

• Exposure to a broad network of innovators, investors and technology leaders. 

• The opportunity to help build a flagship initiative under the European Chips Act. 

• The reputation, expertise and global reach of imec behind you.  

You'll have the chance to influence how tomorrow's chip companies are created, funded and scaled.

Who you are
 

We're looking for someone who combines technical understanding with a passion for helping innovators succeed, with:
 
 

• A PhD, Master's degree or equivalent experience in microelectronics, electrical engineering, physics or a related field. 

• Knowledge of ASIC design and semiconductor development. 

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 

• A customer-focused mindset and entrepreneurial attitude. 

• Willingness to travel frequently (10 % of your time) mostly in Europe. 

• Excellent English communication skills.  

It’s an asset if you also bring: 
 
 

• Experience working with startups or innovation ecosystems. 

• Familiarity with venture development, incubation or accelerator programs. 

• An existing network within the European semiconductor ecosystem. 

• Experience with multiple chip design flows or EDA tools.

jobs.occupation: AP Accountant I FR-NL I Brussels
jobs.description:
To strengthen his Finance team at his Brussels headquarters, our client is looking for an AP Accounting Specialist. 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international retailer known for its collaborative culture, innovation, and continuous improvement mindset.

 

Description

• Manage and reconcile financial transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards.
• Participate in monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities and support financial reporting under BE GAAP and IFRS.
• Perform complex account reconciliations, including intercompany and fixed assets accounts.
• Analyze and optimize financial processes by implementing automation and efficiency improvements.
• Partner with operational teams (stores, e-commerce, logistics) to provide financial insights and support decision-making.
• Identify financial risks, strengthen internal controls, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
 

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Management with at least a first experience in a similar role.
• Strong accounting knowledge with the ability to independently manage complex reconciliations (intercompany, fixed assets).
• Proficient in Excel, with an interest in ERP systems and Generative AI tools.
• Organized, proactive, and able to manage priorities effectively while meeting strict deadlines.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain financial information to non-financial stakeholders.
• Fluent in Dutch with a good command of French and English; committed to continuous learning and process improvement.

Let's talk business
 
 

• Ready to take on the world? Because in this role you’ll implement MES systems at our customers in the plastics and textile industry worldwide. This includes both new installations as implementing upgrades. 

• You'll be prepping installations and fine-tuning applications to ensure a smooth installation at the customer. 

• You’ll install and configure the software on-site, taking into account the specific needs of the customer. You’ll be a guru to our customers: you’ll guide, train and support them when they start using our systems. 

• You will be part of a larger worldwide team but in this role your colleagues from the Installation and Service team and the Development team will be your work besties. 

• When you're not out in the field, you'll be the go-to guy or girl for our HQ, providing top-notch remote support to our customers. It's your change to dive into challenges, solve issues, and keep things running smoothly. 

Let's talk you
 
 

• You hold a Master's degree in ICT, NMCT, electronics or have an equivalent knowledge about MES gained through hands-on experience. We also offer technically skilled school leavers the opportunity to embark on an adventure with us. 

• Knowledge of Windows systems and relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server) is a plus, just like basic knowledge of MES or ERP systems. 

• You're open to the occasional trip abroad to connect with our customers and experience different cultures. 

• As an autonomous, customer-oriented, and stress-resistant person, you thrive on finding solutions and delivering top-notch service. Fluent communication and killer teamwork skills are a must. 

• You can express yourself practically in different languages. Fluency in English is a must, and you should be confident communicating in at least two additional languages to support our global customer base effectively.

Are you passionate about #AI and #cybersecurity? Do you love working with high profile teams with a sure taste of challenge and variety? You dream of joining a fast-growing company with start-up mentality? Eager to learn continuously and drive innovation via AI while securing the digital world of our customers? Join Proximus Ada!

Proximus Ada is the first Belgian center of excellence combining artificial intelligence and cybersecurity. Our mission is to be the leader applying state-of-the-art technology to drive transformation through AI & Cybersecurity Solutions for the Proximus Group and its partners.

Role description

As B2B AI Translator you will help customers unlock business value through AI. Acting as the bridge between business stakeholders and AI delivery teams, you translate business challenges into impactful AI solutions. You identify opportunities, build business cases, and guide initiatives from ideation to implementation. Working closely with customers, sales teams, domain experts, data scientists, AI engineers, and solution architects, you ensure AI projects address real business needs and deliver measurable results. The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, excellent communication skills, and a solid understanding of AI technologies and their business applications.

Key responsibilities

In your role as an AI Translator, your responsibilities will cover:

• Strategic Visionary (30%): Support stakeholders in their AI transformation by helping define long-term visions and short-term priorities. You will design roadmaps, identify and prioritize use cases based on business value, and advise on AI governance and process redesign. Daily activities include engaging with clients to understand their strategic objectives, translating success stories into compelling material, and acting as a trusted advisor on AI capabilities, risks, and opportunities.
• Project Orchestrator (60%): Lead the execution of AI initiatives, acting as the bridge between business experts and AI engineers. You will oversee data maturation, pilot projects with MVPs, and ensure solutions deliver value and operational excellence. Your daily tasks involve facilitating workshops, translating business needs into technical specifications, collaborating with technical teams, monitoring project KPIs, and ensuring AI adoption in production.
• Innovative Thinker (10%): Contribute to the team’s evolution by exploring new methodologies, technologies, and industry trends. This includes staying informed about the AI market, driving innovation, and introducing fresh ideas or best practices to improve our approach and solutions.

Profile

• You own a master’s degree in business engineering, computer science, data science, economics, or a related field.
• You have 3-5 years of experience in translating business needs into technology-driven solutions.
• You have a customer-centric mindset with a passion for solving business problems, excellence and innovation.
• You enjoy being at the forefront of change, questioning the way things are done, rethinking processes and have a natural curiosity, picking up new information quickly.
• Experience in B2B environments and consulting roles is a big plus.
Tech skills

• You have a great interest in all domains of AI (Gen AI, Agentic AI, Classical AI) and deep understanding of its possibilities & limitations.
• You possess a sharp, analytical mind with a foundation in statistics.
• You are familiar with AI platforms and ecosystems such as Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Databricks, or similar technologies.
• You understand the fundamentals of data, including data quality, governance and analytics.
• You have experience creating business cases, value assessments, and ROI analyses for technology initiatives.
• You master PowerPoint and can prepare inspiring & convincing executive presentations, solution proposals, and customer-facing documentation.
• Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI principles, and relevant regulations (e.g., EU AI Act) is a big plus.
Soft skills

• You excel in communication, storytelling and you can explain complex AI concepts to non-technical audience, both in writing and speaking.
• You can motivate and inspire others, and you're skilled at fostering collaboration across functional teams without direct authority and taking the lead on new projects.
• You have strong facilitation and workshop management capabilities.
• You have a strategic thinking mindset combined with pragmatism and execution focus.
• You work well independently and like to take initiative.

• You are at ease with uncertainty, ambiguity and fast-evolving environments.
• You are fluent in English and master at least one of the two national languages used at Proximus (FR-NL). Being trilingual is a big plus

jobs.occupation: Chapter Lead - Automation Engineers - Tribe Customer Servicing & Efficiency - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL 

Do you want to play a key role in the digital transformation of Belgium’s largest bank? Are you a driven people manager with a strong technical background, eager to lead a team of developers to the next level? If so, you could be our new Chapter Lead Developers within the Tribe Customer Servicing & Efficiency! 

Within our tribe, we focus on innovative customer interactions through our Contact Center platform and advanced automation (including robotics and ServiceNow). Our goal is to deliver efficient, user-friendly solutions that simplify life for both customers and employees. Additionally, we play a crucial role in fraud prevention and detection, protecting our bank and customers from threats. 

Our multidisciplinary teams (squads) combine IT and business expertise to develop technological solutions that enhance customer service and process efficiency. As part of Agile Impulse, you’ll work in a dynamic, agile environment where innovation and collaboration are key. 

 

AND IN DETAIL 

As Chapter Lead of Automation Engineers, you’ll lead a skilled development team while serving as both a people manager and a technical expert. You’ll report directly to the IT Tribe Lead and be part of the tribe leadership team. 

 

As a People Manager, you will: 

• You nurture the colleagues in your chapter by ensuring they develop the right skills & knowledge and you manage with them their career plans; 
• You build, together with your peer chapter leads, on a continuous changing and challenging sourcing strategy. 
• You recruit new chapter members in line with current & future needs of the tribe and ensure a good onboarding of them; you are also in charge of the knowledge management; 
• You ensure an open and transparent communication with resource suppliers thinking along in the multiple established value based partnerships. 
• You support chapter members on difficult or complex questions and support them in the necessary changes by developing their agile maturity 
• You provide during the year continuous feedback to your chapter members and are responsible for the annual evaluation and the renumeration decisions in your chapter. 
• You contribute to the daily functioning of the tribe and represent your chapter in the tribe leadership team 
• You help building an open feedback culture at all levels in our tribe and cultivate an open communication and a high level of trust. You act as a sponsor in one or multiple communities of practice (CoP) within the tribe. 
 

As an Expert, you will: 

• Initiate and lead improvements within the tribe based on your technical expertise. 
• Collaborate closely with squads, product owners, agile coaches, and stakeholders to continuously enhance ways of working, tools, and skills. 
• Translate technical needs into strategic development points for your chapter and the Developers Community of BNP Paribas Fortis. 
• Being part of the tribe leadership team, you dare to step outside of your role to intervene when needed on other transversal roles or topics like incident management, vulnerabilities management, DevOps Embedding,… 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES 

• At least 2 years of experience in a similar role. 
• Experience in coaching and mentoring teams. 
• Strong knowledge of software engineering and development/testing methodologies; a technical background in Robotic Process Automation (Blue Prism, UiPath, etc. is a plus. 
• Excellent interpersonal skills-you understand your team’s needs and foster a growth mindset. 
• Agile expertise-you’re familiar with agile teams and methodologies. 
• Passion for innovation and a proactive attitude. 
• Fluent in Dutch or French (oral and written) with strong English skills.

Your role is structured around four main areas, each contributing to the stability and continuous improvement of the IT infrastructure.

License Management (20%)

You will be responsible for managing software licenses, including Microsoft subscriptions and on-premises licensing, Oracle, VMware, Apple, and other software vendors, monitoring software acquisitions, renewals, and retirements, ensuring license compliance and validating software usage and requests.

Contract Management (20%)

• Managing support and maintenance contract renewals.
• Monitoring contractual commitments, service costs, and vendor performance.
• Contributing to the preparation of technical specifications for new procurement processes.
• Ensuring suppliers comply with technical requirements and agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Data Center & Infrastructure (10%)

• Oversee the day-to-day management of data center facilities operated by external partners.
• Coordinate maintenance and operational activities.
• Assess physical infrastructure requirements, including power, cooling, and rack capacity.
• Manage the installation, relocation, and decommissioning of IT equipment.
Capacity & Asset Management (50%)

• Manage the complete lifecycle of hardware and software assets.
• Coordinate the retirement, redeployment, or resale of IT equipment.
• Maintain an accurate IT asset inventory and ensure the Configuration Management Database remains up to date.
• Optimize asset utilization and manage hardware stock levels.
• Prepare and monitor CAPEX and OPEX budgets related to IT infrastructure.
• Forecast infrastructure capacity requirements over a 1- to 4-year horizon in close collaboration with the Architecture team.
• Ensure compliance with IT equipment standards and the corporate IT service catalogue.

Profile

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Engineering/Business Administration with an IT specialization, or equivalent through relevant professional experience.
• Proven experience in IT infrastructure, capacity planning, IT asset management, software license management, and vendor contract management.
• Solid understanding of data center environments, ITIL processes, IT asset inventories, and CMDB management.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft, Oracle, VMware, and Apple licensing models.
• Experience preparing and managing CAPEX and OPEX budgets.
• Strong understanding of enterprise IT environments, including virtualization, storage, databases, and Windows-based systems.
• Languages: French , Dutch and English
• Highly organized, structured, and detail-oriented.
• Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
• Excellent analytical abilities with a proactive approach to optimization and long-term planning.
• Able to work independently while taking ownership and responsibility.
• Clear communicator who enjoys collaborating in a professional and approachable manner.

jobs.occupation: IT Tribe Architect - DevEx & Cloud - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Architecture Department at BNP Paribas Fortis is the strategic backbone of our digital transformation.

We design the future of banking by shaping secure, scalable, and innovative technology solutions that align business vision with cutting-edge IT. Our team of expert architects bridges the gap between security, agility, and customer-centric innovation, ensuring every system-from cloud to core banking-is built for performance, compliance, and seamless integration.

AND IN DETAIL

• You will design and validate solutions for development frameworks, platforms, and toolchains, enabling Dev Engineers to build and deploy scalable cloud-native applications.
• You will produce and maintain high-quality architecture documentation—including blueprints, solution architectures, and reference architectures—to ensure alignment with architectural standards, security policies, and business requirements.
• You will support other architects and development teams by providing expert guidance on scalable, resilient design patterns and cloud-native best practices.
• You will demystify complex technical concepts (e.g., service mesh, continuous delivery, infrastructure automation) to ensure solutions are secure, performant, and developer friendly.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Cloud-Native Development: Deep expertise in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-native applications (microservices, containers) with a focus on scalability, resilience, and observability.
• Kubernetes & OpenShift: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift 
• IBM Cloud Platform: Proficiency in IBM Cloud services (e.g., Openshift and other native IBM Cloud services like EventStream, COS,…)
• Toolchain & Automation: Strong background in DevOps toolchains (CI/CD pipelines, GitOps) and infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible, scripting) to streamline development and deployment workflows.
• Java Frameworks: Experience with modern Java frameworks (Spring Boot) and their integration with cloud-native ecosystems.
• Developer Experience (DevEx): Ability to design and improve developer tools, platforms, and workflows to enhance productivity, reduce friction, and foster adoption of cloud-native practices.
• You are fluent in English (oral and written). Basic knowledge of Dutch or French is an asset.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Build the backbone of our digital future as a Web Infrastructure Architect in our Agile Production Services (APS) tribe. Based in Brussels (HQ), you’ll design, secure, and optimize the high-performance web infrastructure that powers our business, working alongside a diverse, skilled team to push boundaries in scalability, security, and cloud innovation.

If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges and shaping enterprise-grade web solutions, this is where your expertise will make an impact.

 

AND IN DETAIL

You won’t just maintain systems, you’ll engineer resilience, performance, and security into every layer of our web infrastructure. 
Here’s how:

Design with precision

• Craft Detailed Technical Designs (DTDs) that turn business needs into scalable, future-proof architectures.
• Define reference architectures to standardize how we build, deploy, and secure web applications.
Solve deep technical problems

• Debug complex incidents using APM tools, logs, and traces, finding root causes and fixing them for good.
• Optimize performance by analyzing application flows, bottlenecks, and resource usage (think: WebSphere tuning, Kubernetes scaling, TLS handshakes).
Secure and modernize

• Harden our web hosting (WebSphere, Tomcat, IIS) and security layers (F5 WAF, ISVA, API Gateway, oAuth2, HSM).
• Lead cloud migration and optimization (IaaS/PaaS) while keeping costs and risks in check.
• Collaborate and influence
• Work closely with DevOps, Security, and Development teams to ensure designs are practical, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
• Mentor and guide, your expertise will help raise the bar for the entire team.
• Keep us ahead of the curve
• Monitor, measure, and improve, proactively spotting risks and opportunities in our web infrastructure.
